TITLE: Automations

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.MERGED_ONLY_HINT: A pull request closed without merging does not run the rule; its merge after a reopen still does. An issue's close runs it as before.
FORM.NO_CONDITIONS: No conditions: the actions run every time the trigger fires.

TRIGGERS.LINK_CLOSED: A linked pull request or issue closes

TRIGGER_HINTS.STATUS_CHANGED: Runs when a task moves to another status; choose statuses to narrow it.
TRIGGER_HINTS.TASK_ASSIGNED: Runs when someone is added as an assignee of an existing task.
TRIGGER_HINTS.ALL_SUBTASKS_DONE: Runs on the parent when its last open sub-task is done.
TRIGGER_HINTS.SUBTASK_REOPENED: Runs on the parent when one of its done sub-tasks is reopened.
TRIGGER_HINTS.DUE_DATE_PASSED: Checked every 15 minutes; runs once per task and due date.
TRIGGER_HINTS.LINK_CLOSED: Runs when an integration reports that a pull request or issue linked to the task closed.

TEST.TITLE: Test on a task
TEST.HINT: See what the rule would do to a task. Nothing is changed.

HISTORY.TITLE: Recent runs
HISTORY.ERROR: The runs could not be loaded.
HISTORY.EMPTY: The rule has not run yet.

close-parent-when-subtasks-done.NAME: Close the parent when all sub-tasks are done
close-parent-when-subtasks-done.DESCRIPTION: When the last open sub-task of a task is done, the task moves to the first done status of its project.

reopen-parent-when-subtask-reopens.NAME: Reopen the parent when a sub-task reopens
reopen-parent-when-subtask-reopens.DESCRIPTION: When a done sub-task of a done task is reopened, the task moves to the first in-progress status of its project.

status-sets-fields.NAME: When the status changes, set the assignee, label or priority
status-sets-fields.DESCRIPTION: When a task moves to the statuses you choose, set its priority, add labels or assign people.

assigned-moves-in-progress.NAME: When a task is assigned, move it to In progress
assigned-moves-in-progress.DESCRIPTION: When someone is added as an assignee of a to-do task, the task moves to the first in-progress status of its project.

due-date-notify-assignees.NAME: When the due date passes, notify the assignees
due-date-notify-assignees.DESCRIPTION: When the due date of an open task passes, each assignee gets one notice in the Inbox.

link-closed-sets-status.NAME: When a linked pull request or issue closes, set the status
link-closed-sets-status.DESCRIPTION: When an integration reports that a pull request or issue linked to an open task closed, the task moves to the first done status of its project.
